svg.title: One journey, composable expertise
svg.desc: A railway analogy for agent plugins. Strategy sets the destination; workflows offer routes and stopping points; constraints inform decisions; agents and tools perform the work; plugins package skills. Optional technical guidance does not choose the project stack or grant permissions.
svg.text: The requested outcome sets the destination. Relevant skills help the agent get there.

svg.aria-label: A model train with coupled carriages, rails, platform and signal. The surrounding legend maps railway elements to optional guidance and actual execution.

g.text: Choose who the service serves and why.
Enter where needed; stop at the agreed outcome.
Tools and permissions determine actual execution.
Apply the accepted stack; retain the outcome.

svg.text: An explanatory model: guidance does not enforce permissions, require every station or install other plugins.
